description: OSM-Daten unterwegs Trinkwasser auffüllen NRW is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Open.NRW. Standorte, an denen unterwegs Trinkwasser aufgefüllt werden kann in NRW auf Basis von OpenStreetMap. Selektiert werden alle Objekte mit water=refill, amenity=drinkingwater oder drinkingwater:refill=yes. Der Dienst wird jede Nacht aktualisiert. Quelle der OSM-Daten:. Coverage: Open.NRW. The portal files it under the publisher Open.NRW. It offers 8 resource(s) in DOWNLOAD, GPX, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/CSV, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/GEOJSON, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/KML. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
